reviewPolicy.candidatePromotionRule: A candidate must recur in at least three independent sources and pass one generation replay before promotion to draft.
reviewPolicy.observationRule: Titles, captions, thumbnails, search snippets and OCR are metadata only; action facts require direct visual review.
reviewPolicy.segmentRule: An included video may contain excluded transitions or props. Only the explicitly described action segments enter the candidate pool.

observations.entryState: Actor enters or speaks to camera while holding a mug and wearing a plain grey shirt.
actionPath: Rapid character cuts between seated and standing talking-head positions.
Several graphic tees are worn while the actor explains their designs.
One seated segment points toward the chest print.
observations.exitState: Returns to a seated talking-head character after multiple narrative cuts.
observations.productGoal: Comedy-led sponsored explanation of several geek graphic tees.
observations.notes: Useful as an ad-format reference, but not as a default garment-motion template. The chest-pointing gesture overlaps the print and remains narrative-dependent.

observations.entryState: Front-facing full-body stance outdoors, arms relaxed, washed oversized tee visible; headphones and shoulder bag are present.
actionPath: Front view holds briefly.
A hard cut changes to a three-quarter back angle.
A later hard cut changes to a full back-facing reveal.
A separate segment uses a controlled walking state.
Head and gaze angle down while the full back print remains readable.
observations.exitState: Stable full-back stance with the back print centered.
observations.productGoal: Reveal oversized silhouette and large faith-message back print.
observations.notes: The back-facing poses and walking state are reusable, but hard cuts do not prove a continuous turn path. Do not add the bag, headphones or necklace unless already present in the input.

actionPath: Story and giveaway beats dominate.
No stable garment presentation action is completed.
observations.exitState: Narrative ending rather than a garment confirmation pose.
observations.notes: Retain only as a dark-atmosphere reference.

actionPath: Model adjusts sunglasses with both hands.
Model settles into a crossed-arm pose.
observations.notes: Can inform mood direction, but the sunglasses and crossed arms make it unsuitable for the default product template.

actionPath: Presentation is built around holding and displaying a knife.
observations.notes: Dangerous-prop content is excluded from the action library.

observations.entryState: Long-form goth and dark-humor culture content.
actionPath: Meme and narrative beats dominate.
No stable garment presentation path is completed.
observations.exitState: Narrative or meme ending rather than a product confirmation pose.
observations.notes: Retain for cultural tone only; exclude from the default garment-action library.

observations.entryState: Creator holds a book while speaking to camera.
actionPath: Book review and handling dominate.
The book repeatedly covers the chest garment area.
observations.notes: May become a separate book-prop UGC preset, but is excluded from the default garment-action library.

observations.entryState: High-saturation graphic-tee montage with a clear front-print view.
actionPath: Black tee print receives a close detail view.
Purple cat graphic receives a chest close-up while both hands indicate the print.
A pink tee appears in a side or back-oriented composition with a tote.
The final segment includes movement through a shopping environment.
observations.exitState: Moving full-look segment after several product-detail beats.
observations.productGoal: Present colorful literary graphics across several energetic looks.
observations.notes: Corrects the earlier quiet-academia assumption: the directly reviewed official video is colorful, lively and standard-to-fast. Retain at least 1 to 1.5 seconds of print readability.

actionPath: Creator opens and presents the tote bag.
observations.notes: Excluded from the first garment batch.

observations.entryState: Creator begins with several garments in a classroom, then establishes a front-facing worn look with a friendly smile.
actionPath: One segment holds an unworn tee by both shoulder points with the front facing the camera.
First tee: both hands hold the lower side hems while the knees and hips form a light asymmetric stance.
Second tee: both hands rest on the hips with one leg crossed slightly in front.
Third tee: model steps closer for a chest-print view.
Third tee: both hands briefly lift the shoulder and sleeve area, then return to a relaxed presentation stance.
observations.exitState: Front-facing smile with the graphic tee readable.
observations.productGoal: Compare several teacher tees while keeping the classroom context and print legibility.
observations.notes: Include only the per-look actions. Do not copy the outfit-change transitions. Convert the sustained hem hold into one short open-and-release motion. Keep the held and worn states in separate shots.

actionPath: Badge reel is handled and shown.

observations.entryState: T-shirt displayed on a hanger with no person.
actionPath: Product-only hanging presentation.
observations.notes: Useful for product layout, not for a human action library.

actionPath: Accessory is shown without a garment presentation action.
Multiple tees are presented on hangers or as product-only arrangements.
observations.exitState: Hanging graphic tee in a styled interior.
observations.notes: No reusable human movement was confirmed in the reviewed frames.

actionPath: Reviewed frame shows a navy graphic tee arranged flat with no person.
observations.exitState: Product-only arrangement in the sampled frame.
observations.productGoal: Show a themed nurse apparel collection.
observations.notes: A search snippet suggested a worn back view, but the directly reviewed frame at approximately 6.3 seconds was product-only. Exclude until a complete human action is directly verified.

observations.entryState: Front-facing natural stance in a graphic tee.
actionPath: Both hands rise to waist level with open palms below the print, forming a visual frame.
Hands pause without touching the print.
Model turns to a three-quarter back angle.
Model completes an over-shoulder back look.
observations.exitState: Three-quarter back presentation with head turned toward the camera.
observations.productGoal: Emphasize front print first, then show back and silhouette.
observations.notes: The second look holds outerwear across the garment and is excluded. The first look provides the strongest new candidate in this batch.

observations.entryState: Close-up of the garment's all-over eye graphic.
actionPath: Camera pushes and pans across the flat garment.
No human model appears.
observations.notes: Retain as a print-detail camera reference, not as a body-action sample.

observations.entryState: Front-facing full-body pose in a retro raglan tee.
actionPath: Full-body front hold establishes the first raglan look.
One hand briefly rests near the lower print area; this occluding gesture is not retained.
A second raglan look uses both hands near the shoulder and sleeve seams to show contrast sleeves.
A third look holds a friendly front stance.
The final black-and-white raglan uses a slight torso angle and closer upper-body view.
observations.exitState: Three-quarter upper-body hold showing raglan sleeve contrast.
observations.productGoal: Compare retro prints, raglan color blocking and sleeve shape across several looks.
observations.notes: Include only the per-look holds, print framing and sleeve display. Exclude outfit-change edits and any hand placement that covers the print.

candidateActions.entryState: Front-facing natural stance with arms relaxed.
candidateActions.actionPath: Raise both hands to waist level, keep palms open below the main print, hold briefly to form a visual frame, then lower naturally.
candidateActions.exitState: Front-facing stable stance with arms relaxed.
candidateActions.productGoal: Direct attention to a large chest print without touching it.
constraints: Hands must remain below and outside the print area.
Do not touch, pull or stretch the garment.

candidateActions.entryState: An unworn garment is already present in the creator's hands or within reach.
candidateActions.actionPath: Hold the garment at both shoulder points, turn its front squarely toward the camera, and pause without pretending it is being worn.
candidateActions.productGoal: Show the front print during a real unboxing or multi-item UGC segment.
constraints: Do not morph the held garment into a worn garment within the same shot.
Keep hands at the shoulder points and outside the print.
Use only when an unworn garment is already present.

candidateActions.entryState: Stable back-facing stance with a verified back-print reference.
candidateActions.actionPath: Place both hands near the hips or rear pocket line, below the back print, and hold for 1 to 1.5 seconds.
candidateActions.exitState: Stable back-facing pose with the full print readable.
candidateActions.productGoal: Frame a large back print without touching it.
constraints: Hands must remain below the back print.
Do not infer pocket insertion or removal if that path is not shown.
Do not enable without a reliable back reference.

candidateActions.entryState: Front-facing stance with the chest print readable.
candidateActions.actionPath: Bend one arm slightly outside the torso while the other arm remains relaxed, then hold briefly.
candidateActions.exitState: Front-facing pose with the print unobstructed.
candidateActions.productGoal: Add a playful strength cue when it matches the garment copy.
constraints: Use only when the product theme supports a strength or toughness cue.
Keep the bent arm outside the print area.
Do not use when sleeve graphics are the primary product feature.
